title: Converging Richtmyer-Meshkov (RM) instability on the magnetically driven Decel platform
description: Ellison benchmark 3. A magnetically driven cylindrical Be liner (piston) launches a converging shock through a liquid-deuterium working fluid into an on-axis Be rod carrying a pre-imposed sinusoidal perturbation, producing a Richtmyer-Meshkov instability in convergent geometry. This is the QUANTITATIVE ANCHOR for the Ellison ladder (#119): the open-access Knapp 2020 paper reports PDV-measured shock/interface kinematics and the dimensionless perturbation-growth-vs-interface-displacement curve (its Fig. 8). The simulation must reproduce these dimensionless, convergence-governed observables within the experimental + digitization tolerance band.

primary_source.paper: A novel, magnetically driven convergent Richtmyer-Meshkov platform

setup.drive: magnetically driven solid Be liner (piston), Z longpulse mode, 300 ns current rise
setup.liner: Be, inner diameter 4.48 mm (inner radius 2.24 mm), thickness 0.64 mm (outer radius 2.88 mm)
setup.working_fluid: liquid deuterium, cryogenic 22 K, initial density 167 mg/cm^3
setup.target: on-axis solid Be rod, initial radius 0.8 mm, machined axial (kz) perturbation, wavelength 300 um, amplitude h0 = 15 um (peak-to-peak 30 um), kz*h0 = 0.31
setup.atwood_number: A_N = (rho_Be - rho_D)/(rho_Be + rho_D) = 0.53 (from 1D simulation; a setup/normalization parameter, not the experimental oracle)
setup.phase_of_interest: first-shock phase (between t=3085 and 3106 ns in Fig. 1(d)), dominated by RM growth

data.extraction_method: stated numerically in the text (Sec. III): 'the measured interface velocity is v_i = 19.5 +/- 2 km/s'; no figure tracing.

experimental_error.basis: stated +/- 2 km/s PDV measurement uncertainty (Knapp 2020, Sec. III)

digitization_error.basis: value read directly from the text, not digitized from a figure

data.observable: Transmitted shock velocity in the Be rod (PDV-measured)
data.extraction_method: stated numerically in the text (Sec. III): 'the transmitted shock velocity in the rod is V_S,T = 26.7 +/- 2 km/s'; no figure tracing.

experimental_error.basis: stated +/- 2 km/s PDV measurement uncertainty (Knapp 2020, Sec. III)

source.paper: A novel, magnetically driven convergent Richtmyer-Meshkov platform

data.observable: Dimensionless transmitted-shock to interface velocity ratio V_S,T / v_i (EOS-robust shock-strength anchor)
data.extraction_method: ratio of the two PDV-measured velocities stated in the text: 26.7 / 19.5 = 1.37; error propagated from the two +/- 2 km/s bands. Dimensionless, so it is comparable to a code-unit simulation directly and is governed by the shock jump conditions + Atwood number rather than the absolute energy scale.

experimental_error.basis: propagated from v_i = 19.5 +/- 2 and V_S,T = 26.7 +/- 2 km/s (ratio uncertainty ~ 1.37*sqrt((2/26.7)^2+(2/19.5)^2))

digitization_error.basis: derived from stated text values, not digitized

source.paper: A novel, magnetically driven convergent Richtmyer-Meshkov platform

data.observable: Dimensionless RM perturbation-amplitude growth factor over the radiographed first-shock phase (growth vs normalized interface displacement, Fig. 8)
data.extraction_method: Derived from stated text values, not pixel-traced: the post-shock amplitude is h_ps = 10 um (a 1.5x shock compression of the seeded h0 = 15 um); by the final radiograph (z3244 t2, normalized displacement kz*dr = 11.8) the measured growth satisfies kz*h > 1, i.e. h >~ lambda/2pi = 47.7 um, giving an amplitude growth factor h/h_ps >~ 4.8. The text notes the measured growth briefly exceeds the linear-theory expectation (RM linear growth factor ~8 over the full first-shock phase), so 4.8 is a conservative measured anchor and the band is set wide accordingly.

experimental_error.basis: the Fig. 8 measurement carries the interface-velocity confidence band (shaded region) and the perturbation is entering the nonlinear regime where the constant-velocity assumption and convergence modify the growth; the measured points bracket linear theory (factor ~8) from below at the radiographed displacements

digitization_error.basis: reading growth amplitude off the Fig. 8 / Fig. 9 log-scale axes at the stated displacements kz*dr = 5.6 and 11.8

source.paper: A novel, magnetically driven convergent Richtmyer-Meshkov platform
source.figure: Fig. 8 (seeded-perturbation growth vs dimensionless interface displacement kz*dr); Fig. 9 (mode spectrum, kz*h>1 nonlinear threshold)

data.observable: converging-RM inner liner radius vs time (experiment PDV)
data.extraction_method: digitized from Knapp 2020 converging-RM radius-vs-time figure (knapp_rm_r_vs_t.png, 'blue' experiment PDV series), human-QC'd GOOD (30 points, v3 continuity+monotonic trace; the prior trace's spurious upper strand culled). Source figure + reproducible extraction committed under verification/ground_truth/digitization_review/ (figures/knapp_rm_r_vs_t.png, extracted/extracted_points_v3.json key B3_trajectory_liner_exp, fix_b3.py). No fabricated points; per-point error bars are documented estimates (see each point's *_error basis).
